calls.body: SELECT toUnixTimestamp(TimeUnix) AS ts, Value AS v, Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS inst FROM `default`.`otel_metrics_sum` WHERE MetricName = 'system.cpu.utilization' AND TimeUnix >= toDateTime(1791746100) AND TimeUnix < toDateTime(1791750060) ORDER BY TimeUnix
